text:
sam: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2764 is blocked on design verification. I attached a short draft of the change (below) and a link to the design notes. Can someone give an architecture nod and a quick SLO/latency impact check so we can schedule merge? pinging @lisa @kevin :wave:

lisa: Looking now. Can you paste the RFC link? the google doc in the PR is a draft and I want the canonical one.

sam: RFC (canonical): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AAbcD_example_rfc-serve-routing  — the PR is the runtime routing shim to prefer cached KV shards for small requests. TL;DR: prefer cached fast path for <=128 tokens, fall back to default router.

kevin: quick glance — my main concern is bumping tail latency for cold cache misses if fallback isn't fast enough. Do you have a canary plan?

sam: Canary plan in PR description: 10% traffic for 24h, monitor p95 latency and error rate, auto-rollback on >10% p95 delta or >1% error increase. I can add a shorter initial window if ops wants.

jonah: Can you paste the code snippet that toggles the fast path? helps me reason about rollback complexity.

sam: sure:

```python
# routing decision (simplified)
if request.length <= 128 and kv_cache.has_shard(user):
    route = fast_kv_shard
else:
    route = default_router
```

sam: Rollback is a single config flip and a force-evict on the fast_kv_shard pool if needed.

lisa: Thanks. Two asks before I can sign off:
1) Link the RFC in the PR description (not just the doc).
2) Add one small test that asserts fallback path is used within 200ms when kv call raises timeout.

sam: will add both in next push.

kevin: Also: annotate the SLO owners in the PR (link to incident playbook) and confirm that we won't count fast-path cache misses as errors in the same metric. Ops folks prefer separate metrics.

sam: Good call — I'll add metrics split: fast_path_count, fast_path_miss_count, and keep total_request_errors unchanged.

jonah: For the canary window, Ops asked for a short initial ramp: 1% for 2h -> 5% for 6h -> 10% for 24h. Can you add that to rollout plan?

sam: yep, I'll update to that sequence.

arch-bot: Automated check: RFC link present? NO — found only internal doc link in PR body.

sam: fixed: RFC linked in PR body and description. pushed tests, metrics, and ramp plan. PTAL.

lisa: :eyes: quick skim — tests look fine, the fallback test covers the timeout case. I want one more tiny change: the fallback handler should log a debug tag 'fallback_reason' with 'kv_timeout' or 'kv_miss' so we can filter traces.

sam: added the debug tag. pushed.

kevin: ops owners are listed and playbook linked. SLO owner (platform-slo) gave a :+1: in DM.

lisa: LGTM from arch side, leaving an approving comment.

jonah: added :shipit: from me after reading rollback path.

sam: thanks all — scheduling merge for next low-traffic window tomorrow 03:00 UTC. I'll monitor the canary and post updates here.

arch-bot: Merge gate: CLOSED — all required approvals present.

sam: merging now. will report back after first hour. :rocket:
